items.title: Show HN: ADRs for AI – Deliberation records for human–AI work, versioned in Git
items.excerpt: Why is this worth your time? Essentially, this solves two problems of AI-assisted programming: (a) the first problem is how to do  oversight  and  what  do oversight  of  and this is solved through the ORRCF (for  Options, Recommendation, Rationale, Confidence, Falsifier) question format (in which models are supposed to surface all their doubts with fully fleshed out recommendations, with falsifier, to be approved or overridden) (b) the second problem is how to scaffold sustainable AI-written code; the ADRs (Architectural Deliberation Records, after Nygard's decision records) written by the mo
items.summary: ADRs for AI proposes versioning human-AI work decisions in Git using ORRCF format, where models surface doubts and falsifiers for human approval before implementation.
items.usefulness: Could structure oversight of AI-assisted code if a team adopts the ORRCF questioning format and reviews model recommendations systematically.
items.to_verify: Whether ORRCF format actually captures model uncertainties better than existing prompting methods, and if teams sustain ADR discipline without documentation drift.
